hardware: Apple M1 Ultra (16 performance + 4 efficiency cores), 64 GB RAM, macOS 27.0.1; Python 3.13.7, torch 2.14.1 (16 CPU threads), sentence-transformers 6.1.0. CPU and MPS (Apple GPU) rows are labelled; sentence-transformers picks MPS by default on this machine.
note: Medians of 7 interleaved rounds after a warm-up. Other workloads were running on the same machine (1-minute load average 4-14 during the run), so CPU rows, and chunk-length rows in particular, vary between rounds; best rounds are in the raw output. Short texts = data/probe_texts.txt (434 texts, mean 46 tokens). Chunk-length texts = probe texts glued to ~1,190 characters (271 tokens before truncation to 256). The two model-comparison rows were measured earlier with scripts/compare_models.py.
